name: io.github.ipvolt/proxy-toolkit
title: ipvolt Proxy Toolkit
description: Rent and manage ipvolt mobile proxies locally with an API key, or try a no-key sandbox; proxy docs.

environmentVariables.name: IPVOLT_ENABLE_ROUTE_CHECK
environmentVariables.description: Optional local route diagnostic. Set 1 only when you want the extra tool to make a bounded request through your configured proxy.

environmentVariables.name: IPVOLT_PROXY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Private HTTP proxy URL, required only when the local route diagnostic is enabled. Supply through the client's local secret environment; never as a tool argument.

environmentVariables.name: IPVOLT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional ipvolt API key for the seven local account tools: stock, balance, rentals and IP rotation; renting and extending spend the prepaid balance after a confirmation step. Leave unset for the four public tools only.

environmentVariables.name: IPVOLT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Optional sandbox. Set 1, without IPVOLT_API_KEY or the route diagnostic, to try the seven account tools on a simulated account: sample stock, a pretend balance and rentals that connect to nothing. It sends no request and charges nothing.
